issues.description: download_and_untar.sh warns when unzip is missing but does not exit, then proceeds to call unzip
issues.detail: The `command -v unzip` check prints a message and falls through under `set -euo pipefail`. Extraction then fails noisily mid-run instead of aborting cleanly at the precondition boundary. Add `exit 1` after the warning so the script fails fast when its required tool is absent.

issues.description: Usage block prints but does not exit, falling through to realpath on unset $1
issues.detail: When argc is out of [1,2] the script cats usage and continues, running `realpath $1` on empty or extra input. A precondition violation must terminate; add `exit 1` after the heredoc so callers get a clear refusal instead of a confusing downstream error.

issues.description: download_and_untar.sh never downloads and silently succeeds when archives are missing
issues.detail: The script's name matches the ESPnet recipe contract (download if absent, then extract) but this implementation only extracts and merely echoes when archives are missing, returning success. Either honor the contract by failing loudly or downloading, or rename to `extract.sh`. The `--downloads_dir` option in data.sh is also parsed but never forwarded to this script.

issues.description: run.sh sets use_lm=false but README advertises LM decoding results as reproducible
issues.detail: The recipe disables the LM in run.sh (`use_lm=false`), yet README reports `decode_asr_branchformer_lm_...` results. A user running run.sh as-is cannot reproduce the LM rows. Either default `use_lm=true` or document the override required so the recipe's promise matches what it delivers.

issues.description: Unquoted realpath arguments break under whitespace and obscure the postcondition
issues.detail: `realpath $1` and `realpath ${2:-$extract_dir}` are unquoted under `set -u`; any path with a space splits into multiple words. Quote them as `realpath "$1"` to match the discipline used elsewhere in the script and establish that extract_dir is a single absolute path.

issues.description: README links to a config path that does not exist in the recipe
issues.detail: README points to `./conf/train/train_asr_branchformer_e24_amp.yaml` but the file lives at `./conf/train_asr_branchformer_e24_amp.yaml` with no `train/` subdirectory. The link is broken on GitHub; fix the path so the externally visible spec matches the layout.

synthesis.summary: The recipe is structurally conventional — symlinks to TEMPLATE/asr1, standard conf/ layout, kaldi-style data prep — but its two shell drivers leak preconditions. download_and_untar.sh advertises a missing-unzip guard and a usage check that neither enforces, falling through to unquoted realpath on possibly-empty arguments; it also never actually downloads, breaking the contract its name promises. run.sh disables the LM that README claims as a reproducible result, and the README's config link points to a path that does not exist. The transcript normalization and copy-pasted extraction blocks are stylistically weak but not blocking. Fix the fail-fast gaps and the contract mismatches and the recipe is sound.
